events.title: Demo now available!
events.summary: Good morning! We just wanted to make a quick post to announce that the demo is now available. We hope that you enjoy playing and will provide feedback into any kind of improvements and/or changes you would like to see. Granted it is only a small portion of the game but it will be able to give you a good feel of what the game is going to be like. Happy Next Fest!

events.title: What have we been up to?
events.summary: Hello hello! We have some exciting updates!We have updated our gameplay trailer to showcase more of the different levels within She Was King, as well as our Steam Store page artwork. Also, among the store page updates, we have also updated a lot of the visuals, mechanics and overall dungeon level design, new monsters and bosses (which are not presented in the trailer). events.title: Meet the team!
events.summary: Aloha, friends!We know you don't know us, and we want to change that. We're a husband and wife duo who met playing Second Life a lifetime ago. (We know, we know. We can hear you rolling your eyes.) Both lifelong gamers, we always dreamed of creating a game of our own. Unfortunately for us, life got in the way as it sometimes has a habit of doing.
